article.title: Sunrate在香港推出代理付款卡，企業預先設定支出權限
article.title_en: Sunrate announces agent payment card with business-defined spending controls
article.summary: Sunrate於11月2日在香港金融科技周公布Agentic Card，涵蓋行銷支出等企業用途。
article.summary_en: Sunrate announced Agentic Card at Hong Kong FinTech Week on November 2, including marketing spending as a use case.
highlights: 企業可設定金額、貨幣、地區及有效期。
代理按已授權指示付款；操作可記錄及審核。
highlights_en: Businesses can set amount, currency, geography and validity controls.
Agents act on authorized instructions with auditable activity.
article.why: 讓代理處理媒體或供應商付款時，支出權限及例外審批要與自動化一同設計。
article.why_en: Automated media or supplier payments need spending permissions and exception approvals.
article.next_step: 由財務與媒體團隊共同核對商戶限制、審批及對賬流程。
article.next_step_en: Have finance and media teams review merchant restrictions, approvals and reconciliation.
article.detail: 按Sunrate公告，企業可為特定活動或付款任務建立多貨幣虛擬商業卡，預先設置授權規則，並在任務完成後自動到期。代理可建立卡、設定付款參數及取回交易結果，企業仍保留重要財務決策的監督。新聞稿以旅遊平台的活動支出作應用例子，未提供已量度的節省成效；實際申請資格、費用及可用地區仍需向供應商確認。
article.detail_en: Sunrate describes task-specific virtual cards that can expire on completion. Agents can configure payments and retrieve outcomes while businesses retain oversight. The travel-platform example is a proposed use case, not measured savings; confirm fees and eligibility.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
